values.engineering_pass: bound to the fresh Integration verdict on the final candidate (docs/track-b/evidence/cp-21/integration.md); an INCOMPLETE or BLOCKED return yields no adoption decision

adoption.naming: v4 · three-block LightGBM added (proposed; the version is assigned only at adoption, dated at landing)

rule.application: mechanical; not re-weighted, re-thresholded or overridden after results; L-P, L-R and L-N are never eligible; an INCOMPLETE or BLOCKED return yields no adoption decision.

conditions.1: Joint improvement over HG: on the paired HGL - HG differences, the upper 95% endpoint of dS_WIS is < 0 and the upper 95% endpoint of dS_MAE is <= 0.
conditions.2: No regression on the original screen: HGL meets all six original section-8 diagnostics with the saved B0-B3 comparators, as HG does.
conditions.3: A complete, valid evaluation: Engineering PASS with a fresh binding Integration verdict, and every one of the 10,747 keys issued with finite, ordered quantiles.
conditions.4: No resolved per-fold degradation: in no fold may HGL - HG be decisively worse in MAE or in WIS, i.e. no fold whose paired daily-loss 95% interval has its lower endpoint > 0, for each of the five folds and both metrics.

rule.otherwise: Not adopted: a descriptive branch, with the first unmet condition and its values as the reason.

adoption.status: research only; v1 remains the released product and demo; no promotion, freeze, Live or economic claim

bootstrap.ratio_method: R_b = S_policy,b / S_comparator,b - 1 from the same replicates; point = full-sample ratio - 1

research_summary.economics: zero new economic runs or thresholds
research_summary.engineering_status: not assessed by scoring; bound to the fresh Integration verdict
research_summary.inference: exploratory post-selection; no equivalence, absence-of-benefit or absence-of-harm claim; mixed = no demonstrated joint preference
research_summary.native_v1_pinball: preserved separately; mean_pinball_7 is not native v1
research_summary.product_status: v1 remains the released product and demo
